descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator London puts you in the captain's seat over the real London.

THE REAL LONDON
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Houses of Parliament and Big Ben, the London Eye, the Shard, the Gherkin, St Paul's, Tower Bridge, the Tower, Canary Wharf, the O2, Wembley's arch, Battersea, Greenwich, Windsor Castle and 25 Thames bridges. Four airports: Heathrow, London City, Gatwick and RAF Northolt.

A LIVING CITY
The Elizabeth line, the Tube, the DLR and Thameslink on their real tracks, red double-deckers and black cabs on the roads, Thames Clippers on the river, airliners in Heathrow's stacks. At night the West End, the river and Tower Bridge light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
A real-sounding radio: taxi and takeoff clearances, departure, traffic calls, the ILS and your landing clearance, with chatter between airliners.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the Thames at Greenwich, Canary Wharf and the O2 out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: the Heathrow city approach, London City's steep approach, a Thames run, THROUGH Tower Bridge, Windsor, a fighter scramble, the West End after dark and a London tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
